ideas.pitch: A practice arena web app for students preparing for blind coding challenges, featuring audio feedback and syntax memory drills.
ideas.title: CodeClash Blind-Coding Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the unique event format of CodeClash by providing a training tool for the organizers' own featured Blind Coding round.

ideas.pitch: A real-time spectator and visualization dashboard for head-to-head DSA battles, showing live memory and execution metrics.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Duel Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges and organizers face during live competitive programming events by making battles engaging for spectators.

ideas.pitch: A specialized code editor extension that trains developers to recall syntax without visual cues by blanking the screen periodically during timed sprints.
ideas.title: MemoryTrace IDE Extension
ideas.why_it_could_win: Built for the exact demographic of 1st and 2nd-year students participating in the CodeClash foundation-building challenges.

ideas.pitch: An automated test harness and judge system that runs custom edge-case benchmarks for competitive programming problem sets.
ideas.title: DSA Battle Benchmark Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the technical core of the DSA Battle track by providing robust evaluation tooling for real-time problem sets.

ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer coding culture and mentorship matching platform designed for early-stage programming students to find study groups.
ideas.title: Cosmos Culture Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the host organization Cosmos's mission of building a genuine campus coding culture.
